newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Heineken says double digit growth unsure.
newsitem.headline: Heineken says double digit growth unsure.

text.p: Dutch brewer Heineken NV said on Friday that double digit net profit growth over the next three years could not be guaranteed.

Speaking at a news conference to present first half results, chairman Karel Vuursteen said: "Within this integration phase it's very difficult to give a prediction, but over the next three years I don't think you can count on double digit net profit growth."
